steps.intro:
A missing person report has been received.
You can quickly search nearby CCTV footage based on the missing person's information.
Click the [Start Fast Search] button.
steps.review-candidates:
We searched for similar candidates based on the missing person's traits.
Search results can be refined further by adjusting filters and providing user feedback.

Things you can try
  • Click the radius at the top to change the search range
  • Enter free-form conditions in CUVIA Link
    e.g. "Show only people in a gray hoodie", "Exclude anyone holding an umbrella"
  • Mark candidate cards as match / not match

Click a [Candidate Card] to move to the next step.
steps.candidate-detail:
Review the clip in which the candidate was captured.
CUVIA summarizes the key scenes of the video using a VLM-based caption,
and provides a similarity score by comparing the report and video information.

Things you can try
  • Watch the candidate's clip
  • Review candidate metadata and similarity score

Click [Mark as Target] to confirm this person as the target and move on.
steps.route-analysis:
Object tracking will run on the confirmed target.
CUVIA analyzes the CCTVs where the target appeared and the timestamps,
then plots the movement path on the map over time.

This step runs automatically with no user input. The next step will start shortly.
steps.predicted-cctv:
Net-watching surrounding CCTVs centered on the last sighting.
CUVIA jointly analyzes the last seen CCTV and earlier sighting footage,
and uses VLM to infer movement direction, walking path, and street layout.

Click one of the [CCTV Cards] to move on.
steps.predicted-cctv-detail:
Find the target in the recommended CCTV clip.
CUVIA plays the CCTV most likely to show the target
and provides the target's attributes alongside the rationale for the recommendation.

Click [Mark as Target] to move to the broadcast list where you can send out alerts.
steps.capture-list-review:
Review the captured information and create a broadcast package.
CUVIA gathers everything you've gathered so far
and lets you choose what to share before sending it out.

Things you can try
  • Click captured-target cards to inspect timeline captions and candidate metadata
  • Choose what to share
  • Click the Create Broadcast Package button

Click [Create Broadcast Package] to move on.
steps.propagation:
Draft the broadcast message from the package.
CUVIA combines the clips, capture details, and target information you selected
and automatically generates a broadcast draft.

Things you can try
  • Review and edit the AI-generated broadcast draft
  • Check nearby police / fire station details

Click [Send Broadcast Package] to move on to the broadcast thread.
steps.report-download:
Review the report and broadcast history in the broadcast thread.
Incoming reports and outgoing broadcasts appear as a conversational thread.

Things you can try
  • Review incoming reports and outgoing broadcasts
  • Check follow-up requests and replies
  • Confirm the police outcome

Click [Download Case Outcome Report] to move on.
steps.report-result:
AI compiles the entire incident response into a final report.
Based on everything reviewed in each step,
the information you selected, and the broadcasts sent and received,
a case outcome report is generated automatically.

Things you can try
  • Review the final AI-generated report
  • Pick your preferred export format

Choose a [Save Format] to finish the tutorial.
